import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder,StandardScaler,PolynomialFeatures,SplineTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.linear_model import RidgeCV,Ridge,LinearRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error,r2_score
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from scipy.stats import pearsonr
p=pd.read_csv('/work/alloy_pair_target_train.csv');y=p.target; X=p.drop(columns=['target','Fe']); cats=['heat_treatment','route'];nums=[c for c in X if c not in cats]
kf=list(KFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42).split(X))
def evaluate(m,name,X=X):
 yp=np.zeros(len(y))
 for tr,ts in kf:
  m.fit(X.iloc[tr],y.iloc[tr]);yp[ts]=m.predict(X.iloc[ts])
 print(name, mean_squared_error(y,yp)**.5, r2_score(y,yp),flush=True)
 m.fit(X,y)
 return m,yp
if __name__=='__main__':
 for n in [3,4,5,6]:
  for d in [2,3]:
   ct=ColumnTransformer([('num',make_pipeline(SplineTransformer(n_knots=n,degree=d),StandardScaler()),nums),('cat',OneHotEncoder(drop='first',sparse_output=False),cats)])
   m,yp=evaluate(make_pipeline(ct,RidgeCV(alphas=np.logspace(-2,4,31))),f'spline{n}degree{d}')
   if n==3 and d==3:
    import joblib
    joblib.dump(m,'spline.pkl')
    p['pred']=m.predict(X);p['res']=y-p.pred
    print(p.reindex(p.res.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(15).to_string(index=False))
    base=X.iloc[[0]].copy()
    for col in nums:
     xx=pd.concat([base]*11,ignore_index=True);xx[col]=np.linspace(X[col].min(),X[col].max(),11)
     print(col, list(zip(np.round(xx[col].values,2),np.round(m.predict(xx)-m.predict(xx).mean(),1))))
 for depth in [3,4,5,6]:
  m=CatBoostRegressor(iterations=1200,depth=depth,learning_rate=.03,l2_leaf_reg=5,verbose=False,cat_features=cats,thread_count=4)
  evaluate(m,f'cat{depth}')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import itertools,joblib
p=pd.read_csv('/work/alloy_pair_target_train.csv');y=p.target.to_numpy();cats=['heat_treatment','route'];nums=[c for c in p if c not in ['target','Fe']+cats]
maxs=np.array([1.2,2,1.5,22,25,6,1.5,1,15,2,1.5,3,300,300,50,100]); offsets=np.r_[np.zeros(12),950,450,0,0]
z=(p[nums].to_numpy()-offsets)/maxs
cat_enc=OneHotEncoder(drop='first',sparse_output=False).fit(p[cats]); cat=cat_enc.transform(p[cats])
D=np.column_stack([np.ones(len(p)),cat,z,z*z])

def basefit(D,y):
 return least_squares(lambda b:D@b-y,np.linalg.lstsq(D,y,rcond=None)[0],loss='soft_l1',f_scale=12).x

def fit(groups,tr=np.arange(300),starts=10,loss='linear',verbose=True):
 Z=z[tr];DD=D[tr];yy=y[tr]
 bet=basefit(DD,yy)
 b0=list(bet);lo=[-np.inf]*len(bet);hi=[np.inf]*len(bet)
 for group in groups:
  n=len(group);cent=np.array([.35 if i==7 else .61 if i==12 else .35 if i==15 else .5 for i in group])
  width=np.array([.06 if i==7 else .09 for i in group]);amp=350 if len(groups)==1 else 220
  b0.extend(np.r_[np.log(amp),cent,np.log(width)])
  lo.extend(np.r_[np.log(1),np.full(n,-.2),np.full(n,np.log(.015))]);hi.extend(np.r_[np.log(3000),np.full(n,1.2),np.full(n,np.log(1.5))])
 b0=np.array(b0);lo=np.array(lo);hi=np.array(hi)
 def pred(b,ZZ=Z,DDD=DD):
  out=DDD@b[:D.shape[1]]
  off=D.shape[1]
  for group in groups:
   n=len(group);bg=b[off:off+1+2*n];off+=1+2*n
   out+=np.exp(bg[0]-.5*np.sum(((ZZ[:,group]-bg[1:1+n])/np.exp(bg[1+n:]))**2,axis=1))
  return out
 best=None
 for j in range(starts):
  rng=np.random.default_rng(42+j)
  bb=b0.copy()
  if j>0:
   off=D.shape[1]
   for group in groups:
    n=len(group);bb[off+1:off+1+n]+=rng.normal(0,.035,n);bb[off+1+n:off+1+2*n]+=rng.normal(0,.25,n);off+=1+2*n
  opt=least_squares(lambda b:pred(b)-yy,bb,bounds=(lo,hi),loss=loss,f_scale=15,max_nfev=400)
  if best is None or np.sum((pred(opt.x)-yy)**2)<best[0]:
   best=(np.sum((pred(opt.x)-yy)**2),opt.x)
 b=best[1];yp=pred(b,z,D)
 if verbose:
  print('groups',[[nums[i] for i in g] for g in groups], 'RMSE',np.mean((yp[tr]-yy)**2)**.5,flush=True)
  off=D.shape[1]
  for group in groups:
   n=len(group);bg=b[off:off+1+2*n];off+=1+2*n
   print('params',np.exp(bg[0]),bg[1:1+n]*maxs[list(group)]+offsets[list(group)],np.exp(bg[1+n:])*maxs[list(group)],flush=True)
 return b,yp
if __name__=='__main__':
 groupsets=[[(7,12)],[(7,12,15)],[(7,12),(7,15)],[(7,12),(4,13)],[(7,12,15),(4,13)]]
 for groups in groupsets:
  b,yp=fit(groups,starts=8)
  print('outlier pred',[(i,round(y[i],1),round(yp[i],1)) for i in [176,107,38,5,127,245,82,175,254]])
  print('residuals',[(i,round(y[i]-yp[i],1)) for i in np.argsort(abs(y-yp))[-10:]])
  joblib.dump((groups,b),'peak'+str(groups)+'.pkl')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import itertools,joblib
p=pd.read_csv('/work/alloy_pair_target_train.csv');y=p.target.to_numpy();cats=['heat_treatment','route'];nums=[c for c in p if c not in ['target','Fe']+cats]
maxs=np.array([1.2,2,1.5,22,25,6,1.5,1,15,2,1.5,3,300,300,50,100]); offsets=np.r_[np.zeros(12),950,450,0,0]
z=(p[nums].to_numpy()-offsets)/maxs
cat_enc=OneHotEncoder(drop='first',sparse_output=False).fit(p[cats]); cat=cat_enc.transform(p[cats])
D=np.column_stack([np.ones(len(p)),cat,z,z*z])

def basefit(D,y):
 return least_squares(lambda b:D@b-y,np.linalg.lstsq(D,y,rcond=None)[0],loss='soft_l1',f_scale=12).x

def fit(groups,tr=np.arange(300),starts=10,loss='linear',verbose=True):
 Z=z[tr];DD=D[tr];yy=y[tr]
 bet=basefit(DD,yy)
 b0=list(bet);lo=[-np.inf]*len(bet);hi=[np.inf]*len(bet)
 for group in groups:
  n=len(group);cent=np.array([.35 if i==7 else .61 if i==12 else .35 if i==15 else .5 for i in group])
  width=np.array([.06 if i==7 else .09 for i in group]);amp=350 if len(groups)==1 else 220
  b0.extend(np.r_[np.log(amp),cent,np.log(width)])
  lo.extend(np.r_[np.log(1),np.full(n,-.2),np.full(n,np.log(.015))]);hi.extend(np.r_[np.log(3000),np.full(n,1.2),np.full(n,np.log(1.5))])
 b0=np.array(b0);lo=np.array(lo);hi=np.array(hi)
 def pred(b,ZZ=Z,DDD=DD):
  out=DDD@b[:D.shape[1]]
  off=D.shape[1]
  for group in groups:
   n=len(group);bg=b[off:off+1+2*n];off+=1+2*n
   out+=np.exp(bg[0]-.5*np.sum(((ZZ[:,group]-bg[1:1+n])/np.exp(bg[1+n:]))**2,axis=1))
  return out
 best=None
 for j in range(starts):
  rng=np.random.default_rng(42+j)
  bb=b0.copy()
  if j>0:
   off=D.shape[1]
   for group in groups:
    n=len(group);bb[off+1:off+1+n]+=rng.normal(0,.035,n);bb[off+1+n:off+1+2*n]+=rng.normal(0,.25,n);off+=1+2*n
  opt=least_squares(lambda b:pred(b)-yy,bb,bounds=(lo,hi),loss=loss,f_scale=15,max_nfev=400)
  if best is None or np.sum((pred(opt.x)-yy)**2)<best[0]:
   best=(np.sum((pred(opt.x)-yy)**2),opt.x)
 b=best[1];yp=pred(b,z,D)
 if verbose:
  print('groups',[[nums[i] for i in g] for g in groups], 'RMSE',np.mean((yp[tr]-yy)**2)**.5,flush=True)
  off=D.shape[1]
  for group in groups:
   n=len(group);bg=b[off:off+1+2*n];off+=1+2*n
   print('params',np.exp(bg[0]),bg[1:1+n]*maxs[list(group)]+offsets[list(group)],np.exp(bg[1+n:])*maxs[list(group)],flush=True)
 return b,yp
if __name__=='__main__':
 groupsets=[[(7,12)],[(7,12,15)],[(7,12),(7,15)],[(7,12),(4,13)],[(7,12,15),(4,13)]]
 for groups in groupsets:
  b,yp=fit(groups,starts=8)
  print('outlier pred',[(i,round(y[i],1),round(yp[i],1)) for i in [176,107,38,5,127,245,82,175,254]])
  print('residuals',[(i,round(y[i]-yp[i],1)) for i in np.argsort(abs(y-yp))[-10:]])
  joblib.dump((groups,b),'peak'+str(groups)+'.pkl')
